summary: Operate developer workflows, repositories, notebooks, screenshots, and scaffolding.

skills.choose_when: The task explicitly creates or substantially changes a command-line interface.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for a one-off shell command or internal function with no CLI surface.
skills.name: build-cli

skills.choose_when: The user explicitly needs a screenshot, window capture, pixel evidence, or coordinate-preserving image.
skills.avoid_when: Do not select merely because another visual skill will eventually render an artifact.
skills.name: capture-screen

skills.choose_when: The repository explicitly needs pre-commit hooks or commit-time lint/format checks.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for ordinary CI configuration or a one-time formatter run.
skills.name: configure-pre-commit

skills.choose_when: The explicit task is a repeatable migration of test fixtures, fixture formats, or fixture factories.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for ordinary test edits or application data migration.
skills.name: migrate-test-fixtures

skills.choose_when: Git reports merge/rebase conflicts or the user explicitly asks to integrate conflicting histories.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for ordinary code review or non-conflicting branch updates.
skills.name: resolve-merge-conflicts

skills.choose_when: The explicit deliverable is a coding exercise, workshop, kata, starter repo, hints, and reference solution.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for ordinary project scaffolding or production features.
skills.name: scaffold-exercises

skills.choose_when: The task explicitly needs an isolated Git checkout, concurrent branches, or a worktree lifecycle.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for normal branch switching in one checkout.
skills.name: use-git-worktrees

skills.choose_when: A .ipynb notebook, clean-kernel execution, notebook tutorial, or notebook repair is primary.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for a normal Python module or script with no notebook artifact.
skills.name: work-with-jupyter-notebook
